Run trusted YAML workflows.

With a default workflow in wuko.yml, bare wuko runs it and accepts the flags of `wuko run`.

Usage:
  wuko [flags]
  wuko [command]

Workflows:
  list      List effective workflows
  run       Run a named or remotely located workflow
  tree      Display a workflow as a tree
  ui        Run a workflow through its local browser form
  validate  Validate one or all effective workflows

Packages and Plugins:
  install      Install a workflow in the local or global workflow directory
  marketplace  Create and build workflow and plugin marketplaces
  plugin       Install and manage executable plugins
  uninstall    Uninstall a workflow from the local or global workflow directory

Integrations:
  agent       Discover and install coding-agent skills
  completion  Generate shell completion
  git         Integrate Wuko workflows with Git
  shim        Install commands that run one workflow

Help and Reference:
  help       Show command help as text or JSON
  reference  Explore built-in steps, examples, and workflow topics offline

Examples:
  wuko list --format json
  wuko help run
  wuko reference topic agents

Flags:
      --config string           read CLI configuration from a YAML file instead of the current directory
      --debug                   trace workflow loading, validation, and execution to stderr (may expose non-secret configuration)
      --env-loader stringArray  load the invocation environment with auto, none, mise, asdf, or direnv (repeatable)
      --frozen-lockfile         require existing local plugin pins without modifying wuko.lock
  -h, --help                    help for wuko
      --no-config               ignore CLI configuration, including the default workflow
  -v, --version                 version for wuko

Behavior:
  With a configured default workflow, runs that workflow and accepts run flags (see wuko run --help). Otherwise opens the workflow picker in a terminal or lists workflows without one. Help does not load configuration.

Related help:
  wuko help
  wuko reference
  wuko reference topic agents
